job.job_description:
Senior AI Engineer GenAI & Agentic SystemsCompany: Scalong | iBoss Tech Solution Pvt. Ltd. Location: Noida, India Experience: 3–5 Years Employment: Full-TimeKey Skills Required

Generative AI & LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google or equivalent
Agentic AI: Single/multi-agent systems, tool calling, agent orchestration, state & memory management
Agent Frameworks: OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, Strands Agents or custom agent architectures
MCP: Model Context Protocol, MCP servers/clients, secure tool & data integration
Python: Strong production-grade Python development
LLM Engineering: Prompt/context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, token & cost optimization
RAG: Embeddings, retrieval pipelines, document-grounded AI, vector/search databases
AI Evaluation: Evaluation datasets, regression testing, LLM/agent evaluation, quality metrics
AI Reliability: Observability, tracing, logging, retries, fallbacks, timeouts, error handling
AI Security: Prompt injection, tool security, least privilege, guardrails, RBAC, OAuth, IAM, human approval workflows
Backend/API: REST APIs, asynchronous processing, queues, event-driven architectures
Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL, pgvector or equivalent
Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, CI/CD
AWS Services: Bedrock, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudWatch, IAM
Testing: Unit, integration, regression and AI workflow testing
Distributed Systems: Concurrency, background jobs, caching, retries and failure recovery
Observability: OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing
Software Engineering: Git, code reviews, clean architecture, debugging and production support
AI-Assisted Development: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalent

Preferred / Good to Have

AWS Bedrock AgentCore or similar managed agent infrastructure
Salesforce and enterprise API integrations
Pinecone, OpenSearch, Weaviate or other vector/search platforms
Agent-to-agent interoperability protocols
Multimodal and reasoning models
Experience building enterprise AI automation solutions

Core Competencies

Strong architecture and problem-solving judgment
Ability to convert ambiguous business requirements into production AI solutions
Ability to decide between deterministic workflows, LLMs, RAG, agents and human-in-the-loop
Strong focus on security, scalability, reliability, cost and performance
Independent ownership from POC development deployment monitoring optimization
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and LangGraph experience with AWS and FastAPI; transferable cloud skills cover Bedrock and LLMs.
